name: Piper/Ted Smith Aerostar
summary: Fast, sleek six-seat piston twin designed by Ted Smith and built 1968–1984, noted for its high wing loading and speed.

wings: Short-span, narrow-chord wing set low-to-mid on the fuselage
engines: Slim nacelles that blend smoothly into the wing
fuselage: Long, slender fuselage with a sharply tapered nose and dark wraparound windscreen
Row of large rectangular side windows
tail: Tall swept fin with a curved, raked top
Horizontal tail set low on the aft fuselage

tellTales: Short, narrow wings on a long, slender fuselage
Sharply pointed nose with a dark wraparound windscreen
Tall, curved swept fin on a slim tail

confusedWith.howToTell: The Baron has a longer, tapered wing and a more traditional rounded fuselage; the Aerostar has short narrow wings and a long, slim pointed nose.
The 340 has wingtip tanks (early models) and a portly fuselage with small round windows; the Aerostar has plain tips and large rectangular windows.
The Duke has small rounded windows on a rounder fuselage with bigger props; the Aerostar has large rectangular windows and short, narrow wings.
